'''Qista''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who served in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Quesh war]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]], she was stationed at the [[Republic Operational Headquarters]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Qista appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Social Items Vendor for Republic players on Quesh.<ref name="TOR" />
